eyebrow: Lesson 07 · B1 · Good Manners at School · 20 câu
heading: Tidy Desks, Happy Lunches
source: Bài đọc phỏng theo Good Manners at School – Ann Ingalls (The Child's World, 2013), tr. 12–15.
credit: Tranh minh hoạ: Ronnie Rooney, trong Good Manners at School (The Child's World, 2013). Dùng cho mục đích học tập.

paras.label: A
paras.text: Your teacher works hard to make your classroom a pleasant place, and the school spends money on {supplies|supplies} such as pencils, paper and crayons for everyone to use. Treat these things with care. Don't break pencils, and put supplies back where they {belong|belong} when you have finished with them. That way, the room stays neat and {tidy|tidy}.

paras.label: B
paras.text: Your own desk deserves the same attention. Keep your papers in neat piles and return crayons to their box. Don't let your desk turn into a {rubbish dump|rubbish dump}! And never {doodle|doodle} or {scribble|scribble} on the top of it; remember that another student will be using it next year. An {organised|organised} desk shows that you respect your school.

paras.label: C
paras.text: Lunchtime is fun, but manners still matter. Wait patiently in the lunch queue and don't stand too close to the person in front. Say "please" and "thank you" to the kitchen {staff|staff}, who work hard to prepare your meal.

paras.label: D
paras.text: At the table, chat quietly with your friends rather than shouting across the room. It's also a nice idea to invite someone new to sit with you. And of course, keep your food on your plate or in your mouth: food fights are not allowed! Interestingly, in many Japanese schools, students eat lunch in their classrooms, and classmates may even {serve|serve} the food.

paras.label: E
paras.text: When you have finished, take your tray to the bin and put cans and plastic in the {recycling|recycling}. Check that the table is clean, then walk, don't run, out of the lunchroom.

parts.title: Part 1 · Matching headings
parts.instr: Chọn tiêu đề phù hợp nhất cho mỗi đoạn. Có 2 tiêu đề thừa.
options: Being polite in the lunch queue
How to win a food fight

items.label: Paragraph A
items.why: Đoạn A: đồ dùng chung của lớp.

items.label: Paragraph B
items.why: Đoạn B: giữ bàn học của mình ngăn nắp.

items.label: Paragraph C
items.why: Đoạn C: xếp hàng lấy đồ ăn, cảm ơn nhân viên.

items.label: Paragraph D
items.why: Đoạn D: nói chuyện nhỏ, không ném đồ ăn.

items.label: Paragraph E
items.why: Đoạn E: dọn khay, phân loại rác, đi bộ ra ngoài.

parts.title: Part 2 · Reading comprehension
parts.instr: Chọn đáp án đúng hoặc True / False.

questions.q: Why should you keep the top of your desk clean?
options: Another student will use it next year.
The teacher checks it every day.
questions.why: *another student will be using it next year.*

questions.q: The school pays for supplies for students to use.
questions.why: Đúng. *the school spends money on supplies.*

questions.q: Who does the writer say you should thank at lunchtime?
options: the students at the next table
questions.why: *Say "please" and "thank you" to the kitchen staff.*

questions.q: What is interesting about lunch in many Japanese schools?
options: Students eat in their classrooms and may serve each other.
Students cook their own lunch at home.
Students eat lunch in the playground.
questions.why: Đoạn D: ăn trong lớp, bạn cùng lớp chia đồ ăn.

questions.q: According to paragraph E, you can leave your tray on the table for the staff to clear.
questions.why: Sai. *take your tray to the bin*.

questions.q: What connects all the advice in this text?
options: respecting shared places and the people who look after them
questions.why: Bàn ghế, đồ dùng, nhà ăn đều là của chung – hãy tôn trọng.

parts.title: Part 3 · Picture tasks
parts.instr: Quan sát tranh minh hoạ trong sách và trả lời.

questions.q: Which sentence from the text does this picture show best?
options: An organised desk shows that you respect your school.
Wait patiently in the lunch queue.
Walk, don't run, out of the lunchroom.
questions.why: Cô bé lau bàn → đúng đoạn B.
questions.alt: A girl sprays and wipes her desk while a teacher watches

questions.q: Which word best describes the desk after she finishes?
questions.why: Sau khi lau dọn, bàn sẽ **tidy**.
questions.alt: A girl sprays and wipes her desk while a teacher watches

questions.q: What is the boy most likely doing?
options: putting his rubbish into the right bins after lunch
choosing food from the lunch counter
questions.why: Đúng lời khuyên đoạn E: bỏ lon, nhựa vào thùng tái chế.
questions.alt: A boy at a recycling station with bins for cans and plastic

parts.title: Part 4 · Gapped text
parts.instr: Đọc đoạn văn ngắn và chọn câu phù hợp cho mỗi chỗ trống. Có 2 câu thừa.
parts.text: Our class decided to have a "Clean Desk Week". [1] At the end of each day, we checked each other's desks. [2] By Friday, our classroom looked better than ever. [3]
options: Everyone promised to keep their papers organised and their pencils in their cases.
Anyone whose desk was messy had to help tidy the bookshelf.
Our teacher was so pleased that she gave us an extra ten minutes of break.
We drew pictures all over the tops of our desks.
Then we started a food fight in the lunchroom.

items.why: Giải thích *Clean Desk Week* là gì: hứa giữ bàn ngăn nắp.
Sau khi kiểm tra bàn → ai bừa bộn phải dọn giá sách.
Kết quả: cô giáo hài lòng, thưởng thêm giờ ra chơi.

parts.title: Part 5 · Words in context
parts.instr: Đoán nghĩa của từ/cụm từ dựa vào ngữ cảnh.

questions.q: *Don't let your desk turn into a rubbish dump!* (B). This means don't let your desk become…
questions.why: Nói phóng đại: bàn bẩn như bãi rác.

questions.q: *…never doodle or scribble on the top of it* (B). To **doodle** is to…
*…put supplies back where they belong* (A). Here, **belong** means…
questions.why: **Where they belong** = đúng chỗ của chúng.
